evidence.claim: Hanging Rock is one of the quartzite remnants left after erosion wore away surrounding rock.

evidence.quote: The Saura, a Native American tribe of the North Carolina Piedmont region, knew the mountain as Jomeokee meaning the Great Guide. It served as a guidepost also for the European settlers of the Carolina who similarly named it Pilot.
